title: LEO filter sample DNA extractions using PowerWater kit
author: MoBio PowerWater instructions
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.h75b9q6

steps.title: Prepare Workspace and Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare the environment and retrieve frozen filter samples for extraction.

substeps.instruction: Sterilize workspace with ethanol.
Prepare an ice bucket for filter storage.
Retrieve sample from LEO seepage sample box in -80°C freezer.
Crush the frozen filter into evenly sized pieces using a rubber mallet while the filter remains inside the closed baggie.

steps.title: Weigh and Transfer Sample
steps.instruction: Measure the target mass of the filter and transfer it to a bead tube.

substeps.instruction: Tare the balance with an empty baggie of the same size.
Weigh the filter sample + baggie and record the mass.
Calculate 1/3 of the sample mass as the target mass.
Label a bead tube with the full sample ID.
Tare the bead tube on the balance.
Sterilize a clean spatula with ethanol and a kimwipe.
Carefully transfer the target mass into the bead tube and record the mass.
Mark the baggie with date and initials and return remaining sample to the freezer box.
Clean the balance and weighing area.

steps.title: Initial Lysis with Solution PW1
steps.instruction: Add warmed Solution PW1 to the sample and lyse via vortexing.

substeps.instruction: Warm Solution PW1 on a heating block at 55°C for 5-10 minutes to dissolve precipitates.
Add 1 ml of warm Solution PW1 to the PowerWater Bead Tube.
Secure the tube horizontally in a MO BIO Vortex Adapter (4-place 13000-V1-15 or 6-place 13000-V1-5).
Vortex at maximum speed for 5 minutes.

steps.title: First Centrifugation and Supernatant Recovery
steps.instruction: Separate the lysate from the filter membrane and beads.

substeps.instruction: Place 5 mL Bead Tubes in 50 mL Conical tubes (secured with kimwipe).
Centrifuge at ≤ 4000 x g for 1 minute at room temperature.
Using a 1 ml pipette tip, draw up the supernatant by placing the tip down into the beads; pipette more than once to ensure full recovery (expect 600-650 µl).
Transfer the supernatant to a clean 2 ml Collection Tube.

steps.title: Secondary Clarification
steps.instruction: Remove remaining debris and proteins from the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the collection tube at 13,000 x g for 1 minute in a microcentrifuge.
Avoiding the pellet, transfer the supernatant to a clean 2 ml Collection Tube.

steps.title: Inhibitor Removal with Solution PW2
steps.instruction: Use Solution PW2 to remove organic and inorganic contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 μl of Solution PW2 to the supernatant and vortex briefly to mix.
Incubate the tubes in a fridge at 4°C for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at 13,000 x g for 1 minute.
Avoiding the pellet, transfer the supernatant to a clean 2 ml Collection Tube.

steps.title: DNA Binding Preparation with Solution PW3
steps.instruction: Adjust salt concentration to facilitate DNA binding to the spin filter.

substeps.instruction: Check Solution PW3 for precipitation; if necessary, warm at 55°C for 5-10 minutes on a heating block.
Add 650 μl of Solution PW3 to the supernatant and vortex briefly to mix.

steps.title: DNA Binding to Spin Filter
steps.instruction: Bind the DNA to the silica membrane of the spin filter.

substeps.instruction: Load 650 μl of the mixture onto a Spin Filter.
Centrifuge at 13,000 x g for 1 minute.
Discard the flow through and repeat the loading process until all supernatant is processed (total of two loads per sample).
Place the Spin Filter basket into a clean 2 ml Collection Tube.

steps.title: Wash Steps with PW4 and PW5
steps.instruction: Clean the bound DNA using alcohol-based wash solutions.

substeps.instruction: Shake Solution PW4 to mix.
Add 650 μl of Solution PW4 and centrifuge at 13,000 x g for 1 minute.
Discard the flow through.
Add 650 μl of Solution PW5 and centrifuge at 13,000 x g for 1 minute.
Discard the flow through.
Centrifuge again at 13,000 x g for 2 minutes to remove all residual wash.

steps.title: DNA Elution
steps.instruction: Release the DNA from the silica membrane into a final collection tube.

substeps.instruction: Place the Spin Filter basket into a clean, labeled 2 ml Collection Tube (final storage tube).
Add 70 μl of Solution PW6 to the center of the white filter membrane.
Centrifuge at 13,000 x g for 1 minute.
Discard the Spin Filter basket.

steps.title: Quantification and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration and purity using a NanoDrop-1000.

substeps.instruction: Wipe the pedestal with a Kimwipe and blank the machine with 2 μl of water, then 2 μl of PW6.
Measure 2 μl of the sample, record 260/280, 260/230, and ng/μL.
Run each sample 3x and calculate average values.
Perform an internal check by measuring 2 μl of water between sets of 3 samples.
Save the report using the format 'Date_LEO_seepage_DNA_extraction_x-y_initials'.
Clean the machine with a water run and a Kimwipe.
Store DNA samples in the appropriate freezer box and position in -80°C.
Upload data to the LEO seepage microbial communities Google Drive spreadsheet.
Review lab notebook for completeness (date, sample info, masses, NanoDrop data).
